cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.
